items.headline: 年增幅放缓，为何仍创新高？
items.headline_en: A smaller increase can still set a record
items.summary: 10月27日WMO公布：2025年全球地表CO₂平均浓度达426.8ppm，较工业化前高53%。浓度是大气“存量”，不是当年排放量；排放约一半留在大气，其余被陆地和海洋吸收。即使年增幅放缓，存量仍可创新高。
items.summary_en: WMO reported on October 27 that global surface CO₂ concentration reached 426.8 ppm in 2025, 53% above pre-industrial levels. Concentration is an atmospheric stock, not annual emissions. About half of yearly CO₂ emissions remain airborne; land and oceans absorb the rest. A slower annual increase can still produce a record concentration.

items.headline: 让衣袖成为触摸屏
items.headline_en: Turning a sleeve into a touchscreen
items.summary: NUS 10月22日介绍可融入衣物的触控纤维，制成96×54像素衣袖屏。发光芯片呈现图像，按压感应层接通电路，信号定位触点。50次机洗后，发光强度与触控响应基本不变。这展示了“布料变界面”的路径，目前仍是研究原型。
items.summary_en: NUS reported on October 22 a research prototype: a sleeve with a 96-by-54-pixel display. LEDs generate images; pressing a sensing layer completes a circuit to locate touch. Light output and touch response remained nearly unchanged after 50 machine washes. This shows how fabric can become an interface, while remaining a research prototype.

items.headline: 干旱与疾病，怎样重连食物网？
items.headline_en: How drought and disease rewire a food web
items.summary: 10月21日CSIC介绍西班牙Doñana长期研究：疾病减少兔类后，干旱又削弱鸭等替代猎物供应，猞猁转而大量捕食黑鸢雏鸟。受影响成鸟更常迁离领地。多重压力能改变物种互动；这是一地的长期观察，不能直接外推为普遍规律。
items.summary_en: CSIC reported on October 21 that disease and drought altered predator interactions in Spain’s Doñana. Disease reduced rabbits; drought reduced alternatives such as ducks. Lynx then heavily preyed on black-kite chicks, and affected adults more often left territories. Interacting pressures can reshape a food web, but one observational study does not establish a universal rule.

items.headline: 给聚酯装上“酶剪刀”
items.headline_en: Enzyme scissors help polyesters break down
items.summary: 东京大学10月22日介绍发表于《自然》的研究：部分内含分解酶的可生物降解聚酯薄膜，在757米深海五个月内质量损失近100%。酶切断分子链，生成可能被微生物利用的小分子。这是实海材料测试，不是海洋清理系统；成本与规模化仍待验证。
items.summary_en: The University of Tokyo reported on October 22 that some enzyme-embedded biodegradable polyester films lost nearly all their mass after five months at 757 metres. Enzymes break polymer bonds, producing smaller molecules microbes may use. This was a marine materials test, not an ocean-cleanup system. Lower costs and scaling remain future work.

items.headline: 一条“线”换成一片“带”，预测为何改变？
items.headline_en: Why replacing a line with a zone changes a model
items.summary: NASA 10月20日报道：新模型不再把冰川接地处视为一条“线”，而纳入海水随潮汐侵入冰底、加速融化的接地“带”，更贴合思韦茨冰川历史观测。部分模拟的2100年海平面贡献约为旧估计两倍；这是条件预测，非已发生结果。
items.summary_en: NASA reported on October 20 that a Thwaites Glacier model represents the grounded-to-floating transition as a zone, not a line. Tidal seawater intrusions accelerate melting. The model better reproduces historical observations. Some simulations project roughly twice earlier estimates of its sea-level contribution by 2100. These are conditional projections, not observed future outcomes.

items.headline: 图像里的“噪声”，也可能是新彗星
items.headline_en: An image streak becomes a new comet
items.summary: ESA 10月19日宣布，欧几里得望远镜首次发现未知彗星。软件找出移动条纹，预测位置后在多组图像中追踪；地面追加观测后，小行星中心已于10月8日确认C/2026 S1。轨道周期仍待更多数据细化；不是肉眼观星预告。
items.summary_en: ESA announced on October 19 that Euclid had discovered its first previously unknown comet. Software flagged moving streaks; predicted positions linked detections across images. Ground-based follow-up helped the Minor Planet Center confirm C/2026 S1 on October 8. Its orbital period awaits refinement with more data. This is a confirmed discovery, not a naked-eye viewing forecast.

previous_answers.headline: 5×5方格起初全白。每步可选一整行或一整列，把其中所有格子黑白互换。若最终至少有一个黑格，黑格最少能有几个？给出做法，并证明不能更少。
previous_answers.headline_en: A 5×5 grid starts entirely white. Each move flips every cell in one whole row or column between black and white. If at least one cell ends black, what is the smallest possible number of black cells? Give a construction and prove it is minimal.
previous_answers.explanation: 任取两行两列的四角，每次翻0或2角，黑角数恒为偶数。若仅1—4个黑格，必有全白行和列；用任一黑格及它们围成四角，就只有1黑角，矛盾。故至少5；翻一整行恰得5。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Every rectangle formed by two rows and columns keeps an even number of black corners: a move flips zero or two. With 1–4 black cells, an all-white row and column would exist; any black cell would then define a rectangle with one black corner, impossible. Flipping one whole row attains five.

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上期思考题参考解答 / PREVIOUS ANSWER
previous_answers.headline: 不断独立投掷一枚公平硬币，直到连续三次的结果首次出现HHT或HTH便停止（H为正面，T为反面）。哪一种更可能先出现？求它的概率，并说明理由。
previous_answers.headline_en: Keep tossing a fair coin independently until HHT or HTH first appears as three consecutive results (H=heads, T=tails). Which pattern is more likely to appear first? Find its probability and justify your answer.
previous_answers.result_en: HHT wins with probability 2/3; HTH with 1/3
previous_answers.explanation: 设刚出现H后HHT先出的概率为p。下一次H，则等到T必由HHT胜；下一次T，再出H则HTH胜，再出T则重回起点。因此p=1/2+p/4，得2/3。开头的T只延迟首个H，不改变胜率。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Let p be the chance that HHT wins just after H. A following H leads to an HHT win at the first T. A following T then H lets HTH win; a following T then T resets the process. Thus p=1/2+p/4, so p=2/3. Initial tails merely delay the first H.

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上期思考题参考解答 / PREVIOUS ANSWER
previous_answers.headline: 从1至60中选出一些不同的整数，要求选出的数中不存在a<b<c，使b是a的整数倍且c是b的整数倍。最多能选几个？给出一组选法，并证明无法选得更多。
previous_answers.headline_en: Choose distinct integers from 1 to 60. Your set must not contain a<b<c with b a multiple of a and c a multiple of b. What is the largest possible number of selected integers? Give an example and prove optimality.
previous_answers.explanation: 按奇数部分分链u、2u、4u……，链中任取三数都违例。15条长链各至多取2数，15条单元素链各至多取1数，故至多45。取16至60共45数；若a|b|c，则c≥4a≥64，矛盾。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Group numbers into chains u,2u,4u,… for odd u. Any three from one chain are forbidden. Fifteen longer chains allow at most two selections each; fifteen singleton chains allow one, giving 45. Select 16–60. A divisibility triple would give c≥4a≥64, impossible.
